 Judgment

The appeal is filed by the claimant against the Judgment and Award dated 15.05.2019 passed in MVC No.1038/2014 by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM and Addl. MACT, Dharwad, for enhancement of compensation.
2. The factum of the accident, injuries sustained by the claimant and liability are not disputed.

3. Heard the learned counsel for both sides and perused the records.
4.

In the present case, it is proved that the claimant suffered the following injuries:
Fracture of closed mid shaft and fracture of left femur with head injuries and injuries all over body.

5. The Tribunal has awarded compensation as under:
 Sl.No. Heads. Amount  ( in Rs.)
 1. Pain Shock and suffering 25,000/-
 2. Loss of future income 1,00,980/-
 3. Medical expenses 23,000/-
 NC: 2023:KHC-D:10606  4. Food, Diet, Nourishment 20,000/-
 charges  5. Loss of amenities 25,000/-
 Total: 1,93,980/-
6.

Considering the nature of injuries sustained and percentage of disability suffered by the claimant,
the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal is on the lesser side and the same requires to be modified.

7. Accordingly, a compensation of Rs.55,000/- is awarded towards injuries, pain and suffering, a sum of Rs.35,000/- is awarded under the head loss of amenities, a sum of Rs.25,000/- is awarded under initial expenses like food, diet, nourishment and attendant charges etc.

sentences.text:
A sum of Rs.23,000/-
awarded under the head medical expenses is kept intact.
8. The accident is of the year 2015.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.7,500/- p.m., has to be taken as per the KSLSA guidelines.
Further, the Tribunal has taken NC: 2023:KHC-D:10606 whole body disability at 9%, which can be taken at 10%.
As the claimant is aged 29 years, multiplier applicable is 17.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for loss of future earning capacity as under:
Rs.7,500/- x 10/100 x 17 x 12 = Rs.1,53,000/-
9.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for compensation as under:
 Sl.No. Heads.

Amount  ( in Rs.)
 1. Pain and suffering 55,000/-
2. Loss of earning due to disability 1,53,000/-
3. Loss of earning during laid up 22,500/-
period 4.

Medical expenses 23,000/-
(kept intact)
5. Incidental expenses like food, 25,000/-
conveyance, attendant charges etc.
6. Loss of amenities 35,000/-

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of 3,13,500/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.1,93,980/- awarded by the Tribunal.

In the result, I proceed to pass the following:

sentences.text: i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated dated 15.05.2019 passed in MVC No.1038/2014 by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM and Addl. MACT, Dharwad, stands modified.
iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.3,13,500/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.

iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 195 days in filing the appeal.
v) The insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

NC: 2023:KHC-D:10606 vi) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
vii) No order as to costs.
viii) Draw award accordingly.
